description: License manifest for the studio monorepo. Every external dependency of root + apps/*/ + packages/*/package.json must appear in `packages` below with a declared license. Enforced offline by scripts/check-licenses.mjs (`pnpm check:licenses`); CI should additionally confirm each declaration against package metadata (npm registry / pnpm-lock.yaml), especially entries with status TODO-verify.
policy: docs/BUILD_PROMPT.md §16.0 (allow: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2/3, ISC, 0BSD, PostgreSQL, MPL-2.0-unmodified), §16.5 (deny: AGPL, SSPL, BUSL, RSALv2, Elastic, FSL, Sustainable Use), §1.5 rules 8-9 (licensing + attribution).
how_to_add: Add "<package>": { "license": "<SPDX>", "source": "<where you verified it>" }. Unsure? add "status": "TODO-verify". If it ships to users, also add an ATTRIBUTION.md row and ensure the license text exists under LICENSES/.

entry_fields.license: required SPDX identifier or expression (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, MIT OR Apache-2.0)
entry_fields.status: "declared" (default) or "TODO-verify" (declared from offline knowledge; verify in CI)
entry_fields.source: where the declaration comes from (spec section, task, upstream knowledge)
entry_fields.kind: "npm" (default: a package.json dependency) or "infra" (infrastructure component, not an npm dependency)
